editorial:
Imagine walking into a room to interview a guy who looks like he has seen everything in history. That is exactly what happens when a reporter meets a 130-year-old man who says he can travel through time. The whole movie feels like a deep conversation where you are constantly wondering if this old man is a genius or just crazy. It has a very cozy but mysterious vibe, making you feel like you are sitting right there in the room listening to secrets about the future and the past.

The acting is the best part because the dialogue feels real and not scripted. While it is a slow burn and doesn't have big explosions, the way the mystery unfolds will keep you glued to your seat. If you like stories that make you think about life and fate, you will love this. For the best experience, you should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the small details in the set design, or you can just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: At the end, you find out the old man really was a time traveler who tried to stop a huge disaster from happening. He reveals that the future is already set in stone and cannot be changed, no matter how hard he tried. The reporter realizes the truth just as the man's time finally runs out. It wraps up with a sad but clear lesson that humans cannot control time.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves mind-bending stories and great conversations.
